author: alice
title: Retrieval-augmented generation in one page
body: RAG retrieves the passages most relevant to a question and hands them to a language model as context. Retrieval quality bounds answer quality.

author: alice
title: Chunking documents for retrieval
body: Chunks that follow headings beat fixed windows. Overlap a little; keep titles with every chunk so the retriever sees the topic.

author: alice
title: Hybrid search: full text plus vectors
body: Full-text search nails exact terms and identifiers, vectors catch paraphrases. Rank fusion of both is a strong default.

author: alice
title: Evaluating a retriever with recall@k
body: Keep a small labelled set of questions with the posts that answer them; track recall@5 and MRR on every change.

author: bob
title: Event sourcing with Kafka
body: Store facts as events; derive every read model from the log. Replays rebuild any projection from scratch.

author: bob
title: Idempotent consumers
body: At-least-once delivery means duplicates. Key every write on the event id so a redelivery changes nothing.

author: bob
title: Commit offsets after the work
body: Auto-commit acknowledges messages you have not processed yet. Commit only after the handler succeeded.

author: bob
title: One topic, many consumer groups
body: Search, graph and notifications each read the same topic with their own group, so each keeps its own position.

author: carol
title: Knowledge graphs next to search
body: Search finds documents by their words, a graph by their relations: shared topics, authors, citations.

author: carol
title: Modelling posts, authors and tags in Neo4j
body: (:Author)-[:WROTE]->(:Post)-[:TAGGED]->(:Tag). MERGE on unique keys keeps writes idempotent.

author: carol
title: Graph-boosted RAG
body: Expand retrieved posts with their graph neighbours before ranking: related context that shares no words with the question.

author: carol
title: Cypher patterns for recommendations
body: Two posts are related when they share tags; weight by the number of shared tags and the same author.

author: dave
title: Signed service-to-service calls
body: Every internal call carries an Ed25519 signature over method, path, body and time; callees accept only listed callers.

author: dave
title: Least-privilege database roles
body: One role and schema per service: a bug in search cannot read or write content's tables.

author: dave
title: Secrets outside the image
body: Keys are generated at start into a volume; images carry no secrets and run read-only.

author: erin
title: Postgres full-text search
body: tsvector plus a GIN index and websearch_to_tsquery give phrase, OR and exclusion queries with ranking.

author: erin
title: Schema migrations with Flyway
body: Versioned SQL files, never edited after commit; every service's schema evolves through them.

author: erin
title: Embeddings in Postgres with pgvector
body: Keep vectors next to the rows they describe; an HNSW index makes nearest-neighbour search fast.

author: frank
title: Golden signals for every service
body: Rate, errors, latency per service with the same metric names; alerts written once, applied to all.

author: frank
title: Tracing a post through the pipeline
body: A request id travels from the gateway through content to Kafka consumers; logs join on it.

author: frank
title: Alerting on what users feel
body: Page on error rate and latency at the edge; ticket on internal saturation.

author: alice
title: Prompting with retrieved context
body: Quote the retrieved passages, ask for citations, and allow 'not in the context' as an answer.

author: carol
title: Tag co-occurrence as a topic map
body: Tags that often share a post form clusters; the clusters are your topics.

author: bob
title: Backpressure in consumers
body: A slow consumer only falls behind; the log keeps the events until it catches up.
